notes.title: Major drop system update!
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

Here's a quick overview of what has changed:

 Fixed an issue with item drops
 Added progress saving between game sessions
 Reduced the impact of bot holders and multi-accounting
 Fixed a bug that allowed dishonest players to receive sticker packs before the 2-hour timer expired
 Temporarily removed the captcha
Developer Comments:

Since the early stages of the game, we were dissatisfied that the core mechanic of the project was out of our control, which prevented us from fully addressing many issues due to our dependence on a third party.

Additionally, we encountered a major security problem. Due to a vulnerability on Steam's side, there was an exploit that allowed dishonest players to obtain sticker packs unfairly.

With the 2.4 update, we are completely overhauling the internal item drop system.

Roger Miller (CTO) said:
"The development of the new item drop system began at the end of August. It was strategically planned from the very launch of the game, but due to circumstances and other core issues, the development timeline was significantly extended" 
We are also temporarily removing the captcha. Feedback from players made us realize we can improve this system.

Thank you for staying with us!

Sincerely,
The VHC Team!

notes.title: Polishing the Experience: A Minor Update
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

We’ve rolled out an update to address a few issues and make your experience smoother. Here's what has been fixed:

 Fixed a bug that, in rare cases, prevented players from crafting a "Divine" sticker.
 Fixed inappropriate language from the AI that some players encountered.
 Corrected the disclaimer text.

As always, we appreciate your feedback and continued support! Join our Discord community to stay in touch with us directly and connect with fellow players!

Sincerely,
The VHC Team!

notes.title: Interseasonal Update 2.2 is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

In this series of interseasonal updates, we continue improving the user interface. This patch brings changes to the crafting and sticker burning pages.

New Features:
 Updated interface on the crafting page.  
 Updated interface on the sticker burning page.  
 Added new filtering options in the inventory:
 Filter by sticker rarity  
 Filter by season Updated design for the new pack notification.
Fixes:
 Fixed the inability to craft "Divine" stickers.
Miscellaneous:
 The company logo was not moved.

Sincerely,
The VHC Team!

notes.title: Introducing the Interseasonal Update 2.1!
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

Here’s the list of changes in this interseasonal update:

New Features:
 3 new global achievements.
 GPL AI added to the "Packs" page.
Gameplay Improvements:
 Redesigned the "Packs" page.
 Added leaderboard position information to the player panel.
 Added leaderboard position information to the seasonal albums.
 Adjusted the second season album.
Fixes:
 Fixed a bug with stacked packs display (opening packs is now more enjoyable!)
Miscellaneous:
 Company logo shifted 2.5 px to the right in the Boot Page.
 The game now leaves 17% less carbon footprint on the atmosphere.

This is not the last interseasonal update! To stay up to date with the latest news and changes in the game, join our Discord community!

Sincerely,
The VHC Team!
